new_findings_iter1.issue: Emergency bypass is defined but the overlay's a11y semantics are NOT specified. A user in crisis with VoiceOver on must hear the hotline number IMMEDIATELY (not after caption read-through). Live region 'assertive' for caption is the closer of what's available, but this overlay isn't a caption — it's a full-screen modal. SC1 cross-ref needed.
new_findings_iter1.spec_action_required: SPEC.md §8 (or §11.7): emergency overlay has role=alert + NSAccessibility.post(.announcement, value: 'Emergency. Call 1393 in Korea or 988 in the US for support.', priority: .high) on appear. Also: hotline number must be selectable text (Cmd+C) so a non-vocal user can copy-paste into Phone app.

new_findings_iter1.issue: Auto-detect-then-purge flow description says 'PURGES the just-collected userUtterance and any partial Wonder row (atomic via Core Data context discard)'. Atomicity is asserted but the orchestrator might have ALREADY emitted defer_to_human and mode_classify calls before learning the utterance was a child speaking — those calls left logs in the diagnostics dir. Are the diagnostic logs ALSO purged?
new_findings_iter1.spec_action_required: Update SPEC.md §11.7 + data-flow-diagram.md: 'On auto-detect-purge, also rotate-and-redact diagnostics file entries within the last 60s associated with the rejected turn_id.' Document the redaction (replace utterance text with '<redacted-coppa-purge>').
